races.name: Sedgefield Racecourse Supports Autism In Racing Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Captain Cool
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who won here last time out and handles today's good going well

runners_data.name: Diamond Jim
runners_data.note: Highest-rated runner who races prominently and won last time on good ground

runners_data.name: Fine Point
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with strong recent record on good going at this trip

runners_data.name: Maple
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist in good current form who needs the pace to come back to him

runners_data.name: Blackwater Lilly
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse but recent form suggests she may struggle at this level

runners_data.name: Ambassador
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with modest ability but could benefit from a messy pace scenario

runners_data.name: Belaya River
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent soft ground form but unproven on good going

races.paceDynamic: Captain Cool will lead from the start with Diamond Jim, Fine Point, and Ambassador likely pressing him in the early stages. This creates a moderate pace that should suit the hold-up horses Maple, Blackwater Lilly, and Belaya River who can track the leaders and deliver late challenges over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool faces sustained pressure from Diamond Jim and Fine Point through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The pace quickens significantly from halfway, stretching the field and creating gaps for the prominent racers to exploit. Diamond Jim's superior rating tells as Captain Cool tires, while the hold-up horses struggle to close from too far back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool is allowed to dictate a moderate pace with minimal early pressure
scenarios.body: The leaders come back to the field in the final half-mile, allowing the hold-up specialists to deliver their finishing kicks. Maple's recent good form on similar going sees him time his challenge perfectly, while Belaya River also benefits from the scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Captain Cool breaks clear approaching the final flight without serious challengers
scenarios.body: His recent winning form at Sedgefield gives him the confidence to see off late challengers from a position of strength. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on ground that's riding faster than expected.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is very sedate with all prominent runners content to wait
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where positioning at the last flight proves crucial rather than sustained finishing speed. Fine Point's consistent recent form helps him find the best position, while Ambassador sneaks through on the inside.

watchPoints.text: Captain Cool must be watched for how much pressure he faces early - if allowed to bowl along alone he becomes very dangerous
Diamond Jim's jumping under pressure in the home straight will be crucial given his prominent racing style
Maple needs to be handy turning for home as his hold-up style requires the leaders to come back to him
Fine Point's position at the second-last flight will indicate if he can deliver his usual consistent finish
The pace through the middle mile will determine whether this favors front runners or hold-up horses

races.name: Sign Lead Your Horse To Water Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Realisation
runners_data.note: Highest rated but needs strong pace and clean jumping to deploy his hold-up style effectively in small field.

runners_data.name: Mountain Mike
runners_data.note: Solid recent form and prominent style should see him well-positioned throughout this tactical affair.

runners_data.name: Stratagem
runners_data.note: Multiple wins on similar going conditions and forward-racing style suits the likely pace scenario.

runners_data.name: Mary Stanford
runners_data.note: Front-running style but recent heavy ground form suggests she may struggle if pace gets fierce.

runners_data.name: Ailt An Chorrain
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader with decent soft ground record but needs to avoid getting into early speed duel.

races.paceDynamic: Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set honest fractions through the extended trip. Mountain Mike and Stratagem should track prominently behind the leaders, while Realisation will be held up for a late challenge, creating a tactical split that could favor either sustained pace or finishing kick depending on how hard the early battle develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits
scenarios.trigger: If Ailt An Chorrain and Mary Stanford duel hard early and maintain strong gallop
scenarios.body: The honest pace plays to Mountain Mike's prominent style while stretching the field. Realisation gets the strong pace needed for his hold-up tactics to be effective.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leaders Dominate Control
scenarios.trigger: If one of the front-runners (likely Ailt An Chorrain) gains early control without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows the leader to dictate terms and kick clear approaching the final fence. Mary Stanford benefits if she can sit close and pounce late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Triumph
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle between leaders becomes too fierce and they weaken significantly
scenarios.body: Mountain Mike and Stratagem, tracking in ideal positions, inherit the race as the early pace collapses. The prominent runners avoid the early burn-up while staying close enough to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is truly run to suit and Realisation gets the perfect setup from his patient position
scenarios.body: The small field and strong early pace creates gaps for Realisation's trademark late surge. His superior rating tells if given optimal conditions by those in front.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Mary Stanford and Ailt An Chorrain get into early speed battle that could compromise both front-runners
Monitor Realisation's jumping early - any mistakes from his hold-up position in small field could be costly
Observe how quickly Mountain Mike moves up if pace is slow - his prominent style needs to be close turning in
Check if Stratagem can maintain his forward position when pace lifts approaching final circuit
Watch for any signs of the going affecting Mary Stanford who has struggled on heavy ground recently

races.name: Jayne And Greg Complete All The Racecourses Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Clean Getaway
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer who handles good ground well and has winning form at similar distances

runners_data.name: Dixie Cowboy
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with recent soft ground form but proven ability on better surfaces

runners_data.name: Nonbinding
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent racer with mixed recent form but decent strike rate on similar going

runners_data.name: Restandbethankful
runners_data.note: Lacks a recent win but consistent prominent style could suit if pace develops properly

runners_data.name: Natural Ability
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with a decent win record who needs strong early pace to be effective

runners_data.name: Beep Beep Becky
runners_data.note: Patient type returning from longer trips who may appreciate this shorter distance

runners_data.name: Myfavouritesister
runners_data.note: Stays well but lowest rated runner who needs everything to fall perfectly

runners_data.name: Elusive Warrior
runners_data.note: Limited recent good ground experience but consistent soft ground form suggests adaptability

races.paceDynamic: Dixie Cowboy will control the tempo from the front without pressure, creating a sustainable gallop throughout this 2m½f trip. With Clean Getaway, Nonbinding and Restandbethankful likely to race prominently behind the leader, there's enough pace interest to ensure a true test without it becoming frantic. The quartet of hold-up horses (Natural Ability, Beep Beep Becky, Myfavouritesister, Elusive Warrior) will rely on the race unfolding to suit their late-closing styles.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Dixie Cowboy gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader dictates throughout at sensible fractions, building an unassailable advantage turning for home. The prominent trackers cannot match the controlled tempo and the hold-up horses find insufficient pace to close effectively.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses apply sustained pressure to Dixie Cowboy from halfway
scenarios.body: Clean Getaway or Nonbinding force a stronger gallop that stretches the field and exposes Dixie Cowboy's stamina reserves. The increased tempo suits the prominent racers while leaving the hold-up brigade with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the field spreads out
scenarios.body: Natural Ability or Beep Beep Becky benefit from a solid gallop that sets up their finishing kick perfectly. The front runners tie up in the closing stages as the patient hold-up horses find the gaps and momentum needed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses and becomes stop-start with multiple horses vying for position
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with positioning crucial in the final furlong as several horses arrive together. Restandbethankful or Myfavouritesister capitalize on the messy tempo through superior tactical speed.

watchPoints.text: If Dixie Cowboy gets loose on the front end early, he becomes very difficult to peg back
Natural Ability needs the pace to develop genuinely - watch for early positioning behind the speed
Clean Getaway's early positioning will indicate connections' tactical intentions for the race
Beep Beep Becky dropping back to shorter trips after recent long-distance efforts requires monitoring
Watch how aggressively Nonbinding and Restandbethankful track the early pace - indicates their wellbeing

races.name: Fairlight Studios Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Phantom Gold
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter with solid form on good ground but needs to handle 2m4f for the first time

runners_data.name: Monark Wood
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who struggled on heavy ground last time but returns to more suitable conditions

runners_data.name: Fearless Dragon
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse whose style suits this pace setup but lacks a winning record

runners_data.name: Bright Legend
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who may get caught between tactical positions with limited early pace

runners_data.name: Hay Max
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer with excellent record on good ground, perfectly positioned tactically

runners_data.name: Who's Glen
runners_data.note: Reliable hold-up horse who consistently hits the frame but may lack the finishing kick to win

races.paceDynamic: Phantom Gold will take the field along at a steady tempo from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters to challenge him early. This creates an ideal scenario for the quartet of hold-up horses (Monark Wood, Fearless Dragon, Hay Max, Who's Glen) to get competitive from off the pace, while Bright Legend may need to work harder than ideal from his prominent position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Phantom Gold Controls
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold dictates a moderate early pace and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: The leader keeps finding at the business end while the hold-up brigade struggle to make serious inroads. Bright Legend emerges as the main threat but falls just short of the uncompromising front-runner.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely testing from the home turn onwards
scenarios.body: Phantom Gold's early advantage gets whittled away as the race develops into a stamina test. Hay Max or Who's Glen time their challenges perfectly to collar the tiring leader in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bright Legend Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Bright Legend can position prominently without overexerting early
scenarios.body: The prominently-ridden runner gets first run on the field turning for home and holds off late challengers. Phantom Gold battles on but his early exertions take their toll in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Phantom Gold goes too fast early or makes jumping errors
scenarios.body: The leader either stops dramatically or loses momentum through poor jumping, creating chaos. One of the more inexperienced hold-up horses like Fearless Dragon or Monark Wood capitalizes on the pace collapse.

watchPoints.text: Watch Phantom Gold's jumping rhythm early - any mistakes will invite pressure he can't handle
Monitor how aggressively Bright Legend positions himself - too keen early will cost him late
Check if Hay Max gets the strong pace he needs to unleash his finishing kick
Watch for Fearless Dragon getting too far back - his record suggests he needs to be closer
Observe Who's Glen's position turning for home as he needs everything to fall right tactically

races.name: MW Civils & Groundworks Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Byron Hill
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner whose style suits if the pace is strong enough to set up his finishing kick.

runners_data.name: Kopa Kilana
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form but going suits, needs everything to fall right from the back.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Soul
runners_data.note: Hat-trick seeking prominent runner in excellent form, likely to track the leaders and has tactical speed.

runners_data.name: Top Flight Century
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs a strong pace to be effective, recent Sedgefield win shows course form.

runners_data.name: Knacker Trapper
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who needs the race to unfold in his favor, modest recent efforts a concern.

runners_data.name: Achnamara
runners_data.note: Highest rated but tends to race prominently rather than dominate, recent form suggests vulnerability.

runners_data.name: Swingforthefence
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with limited recent runs on good going, needs to find improvement from the rear.

runners_data.name: Mr Globalist
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but significantly outclassed on ratings, would need career best to feature.

runners_data.name: Laddie Cooper Mia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent second at this course on good going provides confidence for similar conditions.

runners_data.name: Seeyainthesuninn
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with patchy recent form, lacks the class edge needed in this company.

runners_data.name: Deauville Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare returning from heavy ground, question marks over fitness and suitability to conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Achnamara appears the only confirmed front runner in this field, likely to set an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul sitting just behind. With most of the field preferring to hold up (7 hold-up horses), this creates a tactical race where the pace-setters get first run but face a wall of late closers in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Achnamara gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: Achnamara dictates throughout and holds on as the prominent runners Cosmic Soul and Byron Hill pick up the pieces. The hold-up brigade gets caught flat-footed by the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapses Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul press Achnamara early, creating a strong gallop
scenarios.body: The prominent runners burn each other out fighting for position, setting up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses. Top Flight Century and Knacker Trapper benefit most from the strong pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Perfect Hold-Up Setup
scenarios.trigger: If moderate pace allows hold-up horses to get into perfect striking positions turning in
scenarios.body: The tactical nature creates a sprint finish where class tells and positioning is crucial. Cosmic Soul's recent form and Byron Hill's consistency see them home despite forward positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get too clever and the pace becomes stop-start with no clear tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where any horse getting a clear run can win, favoring those with tactical speed. Mr Globalist and Seeyainthesuninn could benefit from the chaos despite modest ratings.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Achnamara gets too easy a lead early - could steal the race if the hold-up horses are slow to challenge.
Monitor how aggressively Byron Hill and Cosmic Soul position themselves - if they press early it changes the whole complexion.
Check if any of the hold-up horses get shuffled back too far at the start - will struggle to make up ground in this tactical race.
Watch Top Flight Century's jumping rhythm - needs to travel smoothly to get into contention from his hold-up style.
Observe if the pace quickens appreciably after the third last hurdle - crucial for determining if front runners can stay on.
